description: KNa₂CuO₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal I4mm space group. K is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one O atom. The K-O bond length is 2.82 Å. Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and two longer (2.51 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.81 Å) and one longer (1.82 Å) Cu-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and one Cu atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to one K, four equivalent Na, and one Cu atom.
